narrative.overview:
The page is accounting paper that has grown from one ruled sheet into a full landing page. Navy ink sits on cool paper; structure comes from hairline rules rather than boxes; figures are set in a tabular mono like a column of amounts. One restrained blue accent marks the things you act on or step through. Money states carry the only other chroma: muted green for released money, muted brick for captured money. The mood is quiet, exact, trustworthy.

The page runs top to bottom as: sticky translucent top bar with section nav and a Create studio button; hero (headline, lede, compact one-row entry form, and the looping example booking card over a faint ruled-line ground); trust strip of factual PayPal-rail items; three alternating feature rows, each a text column beside a large product picture on a ruled stage (phone booking screen, proposal card, ledger trace with request snippet); one full-bleed dark navy proof band with a ruled never/only ledger; a 'your rules' ledger with the hold picker; a navy closing band with a white button; footer with the honesty note.

Depth is almost absent: the entry sheet, the example booking card and the product pictures lift slightly. Motion is small and purposeful: only the writing in the example booking replays, figures settle when the hold changes, later sections fade up once on scroll, and the nav and picker respond on hover. Scope: only the .lg Welcome surface follows this system; src/styles.css keeps the older look.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground, near-white sheet, navy ink; one blue accent on actions; navy-band is the only inverted ground (used twice, proof band and closing band).
Hairline rules do the structural work; a heavier navy rule opens each major block.
Figures only in JetBrains Mono, tabular; everything else Hanken Grotesk.
Chroma is reserved: blue for actions and sequence, green for released money, brick for captured money.
Square sheet corners; 4px radius on controls; round only where the object is round (avatar, phone shell) or a chat message (bubble).
Large, tight display type (800 weight, negative tracking) against a calm 1.0625 to 1.125rem reading size.

rules.name: The Money-Only Chroma Rule
rules.body: Green and brick appear only on figures and status that represent money moving (released, captured, authorized or refilled in the example). They never decorate, never mark buttons, links or nav.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one action hue, ledger-accent (#2b4aa8), used sparingly: on the primary action of a block, the active state of a control, sequence numerals, the status pill, and a few signature marks (avatar, entry sheet top rule). Everything else emphatic stays navy ink. A second accent, or the accent used as a large fill or as text color on body copy, is not part of this world. On navy bands the primary action inverts to a white button instead of using the accent.

rules.name: The Two Navy Bands Rule
rules.body: Navy-band grounds are for the proof band and the closing band only, set in typography, hairline rules and one white button: no cards, icons or figures inside them. The rest of the page stays on paper and sheet.

rules.name: The Figures-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono is for numbers, step numerals, picker values, slot times, the never/only verdict words and the request snippet. Prose stays in the grotesk.

rules.name: The Heavy Heading, Calm Body Rule
rules.body: Headings are 700 to 800 with negative tracking and tight line height; reading text stays 400 at 1.0625 to 1.125rem. Nothing sits between them except the 700 subheads.

rules.name: The Lifted Sheets Rule
rules.body: Only the entry sheet, the example card and the three feature pictures lift. Feature text, ledger lines, rules, picker, trust strip and both bands stay on the page plane.

dos: Do let hairline rules (16% navy) separate content; use the strong navy rule (2px) to open a new block.
Do set every amount in JetBrains Mono 600 with tabular numerals.
Do use ledger-accent (#2b4aa8) as the single action color: primary buttons, the active picker or slot state, step numerals, the status pill.
Do reserve ledger green and brick for released and captured money respectively.
Do keep sheet corners square and control corners at 4px.
Do label illustrative content as an example and keep trust-strip and never/only items factual.
Do honor reduced motion by showing the example static and disabling settle and scroll reveal.
Do keep both navy bands to typography, hairline rules and one white button.
donts: Don't introduce color gradients, glows, hard offset shadows or a second action hue on this surface. (The faint repeating ruled lines on the hero and the picture stages are paper, not a gradient treatment.)
Don't use green or brick for decoration, buttons or generic success and error states.
Don't use the accent as a large fill, a band ground or body-text color.
Don't set prose in the mono face.
Don't add a third navy band or put cards inside the bands.
Don't apply this palette to screens governed by src/styles.css without an explicit redesign of them.
